resources.string: If tethering fails due to missing privileged permissions, you can install a systemless Magisk module. This requires Magisk, root approval, and a reboot. Android 15 tethering compatibility is not guaranteed.
Plugin will not work without app being granted system settings permission.
Root access was denied or is unavailable.
Magisk has staged the systemless module. Reboot your phone to activate it. You can disable or remove the module in Magisk if necessary.
No \"modify system settings\" permission. Open config dialog.\n\n
Privileged tethering permission may be required. Open config dialog for Magisk setup.\n\n
Magisk root is required. This installer will not remount or write to /system. If you use KernelSU or another root provider, this version does not support its module installer.

This will stage a systemless privileged-app module using Magisk, not modify the read-only system partition. A reboot is required. A module can interfere with boot or system permissions; you can disable it in Magisk. It does not guarantee that the 2017 tethering method works on Android 15.
The Magisk command timed out. Check root approval in Magisk and retry.
